identityContract.speciesRead: Wild individual island raptor, not a herd or pack animal. Reads as a level-seven mobile threat, not decoration.
identityContract.body: Full body from skull to tail tip, complete tail, complete feet and legs, visible old scarring consistent with a survivor of prior fights rather than a fresh, unmarked animal.
identityContract.threatTells: Skull lowered and fixed toward the weakest stance in the party, weight coiled back onto the haunches for a straight rushing lunge, jaw parted in a snapping display. These three tells describe how the razorbeak signals an incoming Rushing Bite before it commits.
identityContract.worldPresence: Wild and individual: no pen, no cage, no handler, no herd, no other razorbeaks in frame. It is a wilderness encounter that reads as one dangerous animal, not livestock.
hardRejects: second razorbeak or any other creature in frame
